> measured at 614aba5, 2026-11-11, 300 runs, seed 1

Each Act 1 ledger fight, with the player at the level a full clear brings to it, playing each measured deck with the greedy witness. A cell reads **win rate / lowest-VITAE p10** (one fight in ten gets at least this close to death, as a fraction of max VITAE). A measurement, not a gate (D57), and not a licence to tune (D88). Cite it with its commit.

The fighter wears the grey weapon and armor a new run opens with, so the `grey even` column is the "grey even, grey pair worn" column; `grey+bare` is the same deck with nothing worn, the control the pair is read against.

## Reward lanes by character

Each state rolls 400 seeded combat rewards (seed 1). **start** is the run as dealt, the starting relic worn; **late** adds relics until three are worn, each the library lane relic that adds the most lanes the pool lacks (ties in library order). A lane reads its share of the cards offered; `grey fallback` is a pool with no lane in it.

| character | state | relics worn | lanes in the pool | share of offers |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| The Chosen | start | relic-disarming-plea | blood-price, defender, merciful | merciful 54%, defender 23%, blood-price 22% |
| The Chosen | late | relic-disarming-plea, relic-elementalist-signet, relic-crimson-circlet | blood-price, elementalist, defender, merciful | blood-price 29%, elementalist 28%, merciful 26%, defender 17% |

## Decks

- **grey**: 10 cards; dead-card rate 0% (mean share of the deck never played in a cell). Grey pair worn.
- **blood-price**: 20 cards; dead-card rate 0% (mean share of the deck never played in a cell). Grey pair worn.
- **elementalist**: 20 cards; dead-card rate 0% (mean share of the deck never played in a cell). Grey pair worn.
- **blood-price+half**: 20 cards; dead-card rate 0% (mean share of the deck never played in a cell). Grey pair worn.
- **grey+bare**: 10 cards; dead-card rate 0% (mean share of the deck never played in a cell). Nothing worn (the control).
- **elementalist~20of30**: 16 draws of 20 distinct cards from a 30-card pool (elementalist); mean dead-card rate 0% (every draw is in `history.jsonl`). Grey pair worn.
- **mixed~20of60**: 16 draws of 20 distinct cards from a 60-card pool (blood-price + elementalist); mean dead-card rate 0% (every draw is in `history.jsonl`). Grey pair worn.
